flagged.evidence: The postulate defines 𝔄 as “the unital *-algebra generated by these operators” (the smeared fields Φ(f)) and defines ϖ as a functional “on that algebra.” It later applies ϖ to incoming annihilator products and outgoing packet annihilator products, but never states that these operators belong to 𝔄 or that ϖ extends to an algebra containing them. K is only required to be real-linear with K(Pf)=0, which does not establish that inclusion. Thus those uses of ϖ are outside its declared domain.
